review_candidates.title: Infra Tech Support Practitioner
review_candidates.description: Project Role : Infra Tech Support Practitioner Project Role Description : Provide L1–L2 technical support for infrastructure, systems, and applications in production and development environments, both remotely and onsite, following defined operating models and processes. Act as the primary interface with users/clients to accurately diagnose issues and deliver effective resolutions across infrastructure, operating systems, networks, and application platforms, ensuring service stability and quality support. Must have skills : VMware Datacenter Virtualization Architecture and Design Good to have skills : Vmware Virtualization Administration Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As a Storage & Virtualization Systems Engineer (m/f/d) within Global Data Center Operations, you design, operate, and continuously optimize large-scale, mission-critical compute and storage platforms across multiple enterprise data centers. You contribute to global platform architecture, ensure standardization and resilience, and support 24x7 enterprise operations in a globally distributed environment. Roles & Responsibilities: Design, operate, and optimize enterprise-scale compute and storage platforms across global data centers and hybrid environments. Architect, standardize, and operate VMware-based SDDC platforms including vSphere, vCenter, NSX, and Aria vRealize Operations. Manage x86 server platforms (Dell, HPE, Lenovo), including lifecycle management, firmware governance, and capacity planning. Design and operate global storage platforms including Brocade SAN, NetApp NAS (MetroCluster, replication, cloning), StorageGRID, and Pure Storage(FlashArray, FlashBlade). Define and operate enterprise backup and disaster recovery standards using Commvault Backup. Execute global infrastructure initiatives such as data center migrations, platform upgrades, standardization, and legacy decommissioning. Drive automation and operational efficiency using scripting, GitLab CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as code. Act as escalation point for complex incidents, leading root cause analysis and long-term remediation. Collaborate with global network, security, cloud, and application teams to deliver end-to-end infrastructure solutions. Create and maintain global architecture documentation, operational standards, and runbooks. Participate in on-call and shift-based rotations as part of a 24 7 follow-the-sun operations model. Professional & Technical Skills: 3+ years of experience in enterprise or global data center operations. Strong expertise in VMware technologies including vSphere, vCenter, NSX, and Aria vRealize Operations. Hands-on experience with x86 server infrastructures from Dell, HPE, and Lenovo. In-depth knowledge of Brocade SAN fabrics, zoning, and enterprise-scale SAN design. Strong experience with NetApp storage solutions including NAS, MetroCluster, replication, and cloning. Experience with NetApp StorageGRID and object storage architectures. Hands-on experience with Pure Storage platforms including FlashArray and FlashBlade. Solid understanding of enterprise backup, recovery, and business continuity using Commvault Backup & Recovery. Scripting skills in Python and PowerShell for automation and operational tooling. Strong hands-on experience with Ansible for automated configuration management and deployment. Experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) methodologies. Strong knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, and resilience design. Ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams with strong communication skills. Fluent English communication skills. Additional Information: The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in VMware Datacenter Virtualization Architecture and Design. This position is based at our Chennai office. A 15 years full time education is required.

review_candidates.title: Azure Cloud Engineer
review_candidates.description: Overview It's an exciting time to join Fisher Investments! We're continuing to invest in the future of our firm's technology and information security. Our business is growing internationally, which emphasizes the need to build an unparalleled global team that inspires future scale through strategic solutions, innovation, mentoring, and tight knit teamwork. The Opportunity: As a Cloud Engineer, you will consult and contribute to business process improvements of IT policies, procedures, tools, security controls and infrastructure. You will maintain the operational Azure cloud environment, perform infrastructure deployments and ensure the production environment is operating securely and efficiently using automation tools. You will work with Infrastructure Engineering to make sure all deployments follow standards, are compliant and secure. You will report to the Application Development Team Lead. The Day-to-Day: Develop, implement and maintain scalable Cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure platform Collaborate with partners to understand their cloud requirements and design effective solutions Recommend Cloud & AI-based solutions, document and communicate with all partners Deploy enterprise scaled cloud resources that can be used across technology organizations using code Follow security audit requirements and controls in every action Use configuration management and automated deployment tools to provide cloud-based solutions and services ensuring best practices Work with solution architects, tech leads and partners to confirm developed solutions align with existing standards, meet security controls and meet cloud computing best practices Provide international and 24/7 support through on-call duties and working a flexible off-hours schedule for planned and unplanned maintenance Your Qualifications: 8+ years of experience deploying resources and managing infrastructure through both manual and automated pipelines in an IT infrastructure and operational environment 5+ years of experience Maintain resources in cross platform environments Azure cloud infrastructure deployments using IaC Build, deploying and managing public cloud IaaS and PaaS services Deploy resources using Terraform 4+ years of experience GitHub and GitHub Actions Build automated cloud infrastructure across multiple Production and Non-Production environments Scripting and automating builds, workflows, tasks and other integration aspects Azure CLI 3+ years of experience CI/CD pipelines, YAML/YML for GitHub actions Troubleshoot in an Azure Cloud environment 1+ year hands on experience Deploy, operate, and maintain Kubernetes-based platforms AI platforms such as Microsoft Azure AI or similar cloud-based AI services preferred Experience with Azure IaaS (Virtual Machines, Storage, Networking) and PaaS (App Services, Azure SQL, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory) Knowledge of identity management, security controls, compliance and encryption Bachelor's degree in MIS, Computer Science, or a related field Why Fisher Investments: We work for a bigger purpose: bettering the investment universe. We take great pride in our inclusive culture, our learning and development framework customized for every employee, and our Great Place to Work Certification. It's the people that make the Fisher purpose possible, and we invest in them by offering exceptional benefits like: 100% paid medical, dental and vision premiums for you and your qualifying dependents A 50% 401(k) match, up to the IRS maximum 20 days of PTO, plus 10 paid holidays Family Support programs including 8 week Paid Primary Caregiver Leave, $10,000 fertility, family forming, and hormonal health assistance, and back-up child, adult, and elder care This is an in-office role. Based on your role, tenure, and performance eligibility you may have the opportunity to participate in our hybrid work from home program. This program is subject to change. FISHER INVESTMENTS IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

review_candidates.title: Information Technology Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description Larin’s Fashion is a retail company with an online fashion store offering a wide range of trendy and affordable clothing options for women, and factory B2B . The brand focuses on delivering the latest fashion trends at accessible prices while helping customers feel confident and stylish. Larin’s Fashion emphasizes inclusive fashion by providing free shipping on orders over $100 and maintaining a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. The customer service team is readily available to support shoppers with questions or concerns, contributing to a positive and reliable online shopping experience. Applicants joining Larin’s Fashion will be part of a growing, customer-centered fashion business. Role Description The Information Technology Specialist will support and maintain the technology infrastructure that powers Larin’s Fashion’s online and retail operations. This full-time, on-site role based in Giza involves monitoring and managing network systems, ensuring secure and stable connectivity, and resolving technical issues for internal users. Day-to-day responsibilities include troubleshooting hardware and software problems, maintaining network and server performance, implementing security practices, and coordinating with external vendors when needed. The specialist will also assist staff with IT-related requests, contribute to system upgrades, and help optimize technology solutions that enhance online store performance and internal workflows. Qualifications Strong foundation in Information Technology, including systems, hardware, and software management. Proficiency in Network Administration and Network Security to ensure reliable and secure connectivity. Solid Troubleshooting skills for diagnosing and resolving technical issues in a timely manner. Customer Service skills for supporting internal users and communicating technical information clearly. Experience with retail or e-commerce environments is beneficial. Ability to work on-site in Giza and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Relevant IT certifications or a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred. Awareness of data protection and cybersecurity best practices.

review_candidates.title: Technology Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: Project Role : Technology Support Engineer Project Role Description : Resolve incidents and problems across multiple business system components and ensure operational stability. Create and implement Requests for Change (RFC) and update knowledge base articles to support effective troubleshooting. Collaborate with vendors and help service management teams with issue analysis and resolution. Must have skills : SD-WAN Operations Good to have skills : NA Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As an Application Tech Support Practitioner, you will act as the ongoing interface between the client and the system or application. Dedicated to quality, using exceptional communication skills to keep our world-class systems running. You can accurately define a client issue and interpret and design a resolution based on deep product knowledge. Roles & Responsibilities: Expected to perform independently and become an SME. Required active participation/contribution in team discussions. Contribute in providing solutions to work-related problems. Provide timely and effective technical support to clients. Troubleshoot and resolve system or application issues. Document client issues and resolutions for future reference. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance system performance. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices. Professional & Technical Skills: Mandatory Basic Networking skills : Routing & Switching (CCNA, JNCIA equivalent) Must to Have Skills (Minimum 2 should have from listed skills) : Cisco Viptela, Cisco Meraki, Juniper MIST, Prisma SDWAN, Fortinet SDWAN, CATO SDWAN, Versa SDWAN, HPE Silverpeak Good to have Skills (Minimum 2 should have from listed skills) : Python, Ansible, Terraform, Git, REST APIs, CI/CD Good to have knowledge on Skills (Minimum 1 should have from listed skills) : Cloud Networking, Automation, Wireless, Firewalls Proficiency in SD-WAN Operations and implementation Strong understanding of network protocols and configurations. Experience in designing and deployment of SDWAN network. (Optional) Experience in troubleshooting network connectivity issues. Knowledge of ITIL framework for service management. Hands-on Experience with network monitoring tools. Additional Information: Flexible to work in 24x7 rotational shifts, including weekend Excellent communication skills A 15 years full time education is required.
